name: Phone plan compare
pitch: Find two phone plans and show their price and data side by side.
instructions: Search the web for two phone plans. Read the price and data allowance from the results. If fewer than two plans are found, say so and stop. If a price or data amount cannot be read, note that it was not available. Use show_comparison to place the two plans side by side, listing price and data for each. If only one plan is found, tell the person and ask if they want to search for another. When the comparison is ready, display the table to the person.

examples.does: search the web for phone plans and show a side-by-side comparison

readme:
# Phone plan compare
Finds two phone plans and shows their price and data side by side.

Needs: web_search, show_comparison.
Will not: sign up for a plan or give personal data to anyone.
